Delay in match because of an injury Marc Oliver Kempf (Como).

Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Lens 0, Como 2. Tasos Douvikas (Como) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Álex Valle.
Samson Baidoo (Lens) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Lens 0, Como 3. Nico Paz (Como) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Tasos Douvikas following a fast break.
Substitution, Lens. Saud Abdulhamid replaces Michal Skóras.
